request.reason: Wave-2 repair only. Merge semantically equivalent owner statements into one canonical retrieval page instead of per-source retellings. For every recurring position, state the exact count of distinct source records, earliest and latest dated occurrence with source links, current formulation, and any change or contradiction. Create a dedicated page for the OpenViking chat-recall knowledge-library outcome and its boundaries because the source holder contains it. Preserve provenance; if evidence is insufficient, say so rather than infer. Use stock English Wiki behavior; no prompt/Skill fork, no ontology fork, no full backfill.

recurrence_counts.title: Capture owner statements as dated quotes, but in shortened essence form
The skill is global and should run automatically
Search aids may help find the right session, but they do not prove the owner's position
Backfilling session context requires reading the real sessions, not only quote snippets
The runtime skill should stay simple and should not record unproven claims
